svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: One build, blue to green
svg.desc: One build, blue to green. Sequence diagram with 8 participants (GitHub repository, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, Amazon Elastic Container Registry, AWS CodeDeploy, CloudWatch alarms, Amazon Elastic Container Service, Application Load Balancer) and 16 messages. 1. GitHub repository to AWS CodePipeline (push); 2. AWS CodePipeline to AWS CodeBuild (StartBuild (source)); 3. AWS CodeBuild to itself (80% test gate, docker build); 4. AWS CodeBuild to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (docker push); 5. Amazon Elastic Container Registry to AWS CodeBuild (sha256 digest); 6. AWS CodeBuild to AWS CodePipeline (taskdef.json, imageDetail.json); 7. AWS CodePipeline to AWS CodeDeploy (Deploy-Test: new task definition, appspec.yml); 8. AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon Elastic Container Service (CreateTaskSet (green)); 9. AWS CodeDeploy to Application Load Balancer (:8080 test listener to green); 10. AWS CodeDeploy to Application Load Balancer (30% of :80 to green for 1 min); 11. AWS CodeDeploy to CloudWatch alarms (DescribeAlarms); 12. CloudWatch alarms to AWS CodeDeploy (alarm states); 13. AWS CodeDeploy to Application Load Balancer (all of :80 back to blue); 14. AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon Elastic Container Service (delete green task set); 15. AWS CodeDeploy to Application Load Balancer (other 70% of :80 to green); 16. AWS CodeDeploy to Amazon Elastic Container Service (delete blue task set after 1 min). Fragments: alt [an alarm in ALARM] over messages 13 to 16, else [both alarms OK] from 15.

text.tspan: Main pipeline into test, deployment_engine = codedeploy (default). Prod repeats it after Manual-Approval with the same artifact; the ecs engine makes the same shifts on listener-rule
weights and also rolls back on its circuit breaker.
